task: FV2-048 — Flutter audio settings responsive and accessibility acceptance
summary: Made the VAD/PTT activation selector keyboard-focusable and semantically explicit, with a vertical compact layout at enlarged text scales so option labels remain readable. Added regressions for selected semantics, dBFS slider value, large text, short landscape windows, and keyboard traversal.

checks.name: Large accessibility text regression before implementation
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'large accessibility text keeps audio activation labels readable'
checks.observation: At 2.5x text scaling the fixed-height horizontal activation selector clipped labels; the test observed the selector remaining at its compact fixed height.

checks.name: Workspace UI tests
checks.observation: Includes activation selected/button semantics, sensitivity value in dBFS, large text, landscape/short-window reachability, and keyboard Tab/Enter selection.

checks.name: Changed-file analysis and formatting
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter analyze --no-pub lib/src/screens/workspace_screen.dart test/workspace_screen_test.dart; dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib/src/screens/workspace_screen.dart test/workspace_screen_test.dart
checks.observation: No analyzer issues; both Dart files are formatted.

checks.name: macOS Debug build
checks.observation: Built current source without restarting the running Mac app.

checks.name: Android arm64 Debug build
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter build apk --debug --no-pub --target-platform android-arm64 --quiet

checks.name: Native screen-reader acceptance
checks.observation: VoiceOver/TalkBack spoken output and navigation have not been checked in a live client. The running Mac app had no Flutter VM service for hot reload, and it was not restarted to avoid triggering the Keychain prompt.
